title: Death bursts and gore chunks (voxel-lit, bouncing, pooled)
player_outcome: Kills burst: a spray of blood, gel or bone dust plus a few chunks that tumble, bounce off the terrain and fade. There is no more white glowing sphere puff, and in dark caves the burst is dark too.
design: Verified: Killed → Puff with an Unshaded sphere material (CombatEffects.cs:17, 94); non-human corpses just shrink.
New game/Entities/GoreSystem.cs: one MultiMesh (box and sphere shared meshes, prop shader with light_from_custom). Capacity by preset: 16/32/64/96 chunks.

Each chunk: position, velocity, angular velocity, life 2.5 s with fade in the final 0.4 s. Gravity is 18 m/s². Voxel collision tests World.IsSolid at the next cell, bouncing 0.35 with ground friction. Custom data = voxel light (sampled every 4th frame) + colour. The oldest chunk is recycled.
On Killed: EffectKit.Burst(material dust recipe, count 25 × scale) + GoreSystem.Spawn(material.gore.pieces (2–4; bosses 8), size from HalfExtents, colour from material/Tint).
Critters (tag critter): a small puff only. Humanoid corpses (KeepCorpse) get dust only.
Remove the remaining sphere Puff helper; liquid steam and burning items already use EffectKit (P3-08).
data_changes: creature_materials.json gore per material: flesh 3 dark-red boxes; gel 3 tinted spheres; bone 4 ivory boxes; metal 3 grey boxes + sparks; plant 3 green leaves
verification: perf: slay 30 creatures at once → gd.gore < 0.5 ms and no frame > 25 ms (perf report max)
Lavapipe screenshots of kills at day and in a cave
risks: Voxel collision on unloaded chunks: treat unknown cells as air and kill chunks below y < 0.
